title: Google launches Gemini 4 Argon, its most powerful AI model, but fails to surpass OpenAI and Anthropic
summary: The new model closes the gap with competitors though it doesn't take a clear lead, and is offered first to cybersecurity defenders.

title: TP-Link opens global pre-sale of first Wi-Fi 8 router, but US market excluded due to FCC block
summary: The device reaches 19 Gbps with 18 antennas, though federal ban prevents its sale in the US while security risks are reviewed.

title: Pentagon recruits Elon Musk and Palmer Luckey to define future US military strategy
summary: Both technologists will have 120 days to map out the next American wars under Department of Defense supervision.

title: Electric BMW 3 Series costs $4,400 less than its gasoline equivalent in US market
summary: The sedan's electric version is cheaper than the combustion M350, breaking the premium pricing trend for EVs.

title: Borderless Gaming implements DLSS 5 Neural Rendering universally without need for per-game mods
summary: The tool enables leveraging NVIDIA's new upscaling technology in any compatible title without individual modifications.

title: Reddit removes RSS feeds and closes public API access citing AI bot abuse
summary: The platform restricts content distribution to prevent unauthorized training of artificial intelligence models.

title: KytyPS5 emulator manages to run Marvel's Wolverine on PC before official game launch
summary: PlayStation 5 emulator progress allows testing Insomniac Games title on computers, anticipating potential performance improvements.

title: Artificial intelligence cost falls faster than Moore's Law, according to recent report
summary: Inference and training expenses plummet, surpassing historical cost reductions in computing, DNA sequencing, and batteries.

title: Massive leak exposes sensitive data of nearly three million Pentagon military and civilian personnel
summary: The breach includes Social Security numbers and employment records, compromising security of active and retired personnel.

title: Microsoft launches Windows 11 26H2 expanding system support and activating features it kept inactive
summary: The update extends the OS lifecycle and enables previously dormant features to improve user experience.
